name: VA disability compensation recipients by county and combined rating
description: Veterans receiving VA disability compensation in every U.S. county on September 30, 2025 (fiscal year 2025), from the Department of Veterans Affairs county file on data.va.gov: the total and the count in each combined service-connected rating band (0 to 20%, 30 to 40%, 50 to 60%, 70 to 90% and 100%), by age group (17 to 44, 45 to 64, 65 and over) and by sex, with the same county's total and 100% count a year earlier. One record per county (3,144, in the 50 states and DC), per state and DC (the sum of its counties), for Puerto Rico, for the other territories, for veterans paid abroad, for unknown addresses and for the US. Every figure is one VA publishes; none is estimated.
citeAs: Probative Growth. (2026). VA disability compensation recipients by county and combined rating (Version 2.0.0) [Data set]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23898138

distribution.name: va-compensation.csv
distribution.description: Every record, one row each (RFC 4180, UTF-8). Columns are described in README.txt.

distribution.name: va-compensation.json
distribution.description: Every record with its full sources, under a meta envelope (credit line, DOI, license).

distribution.name: va-compensation-values.csv
distribution.description: The columns listed in README.txt as being in va-compensation-values.csv, one row per id, column and value; join it to va-compensation.csv on id.

recordSet.name: va-compensation
recordSet.description: The records of VA disability compensation recipients by county and combined rating, one per CSV row.

field.name: jurisdiction
field.description: Two-letter code of the state, DC or Puerto Rico, or US (the US record and the rows for other territories, veterans abroad and unknown addresses)

field.name: level
field.description: county, state (states, DC and Puerto Rico), other-territories, abroad, unknown or us

field.name: fiscalYear
field.description: VA fiscal year of the count (it ends September 30)

field.name: asOf
field.description: The day the count describes: veterans receiving compensation on September 30 of the fiscal year

field.name: status
field.description: P primary source, S secondary source

field.name: text
field.description: The record in one plain-English sentence

field.name: effectiveFrom
field.description: When the fact took effect (YYYY-MM-DD), if known

field.name: effectiveTo
field.description: When it stopped applying; empty while current

field.name: lastChecked
field.description: The day it was last confirmed (YYYY-MM-DD)

field.name: sourceUrls
field.description: Source URLs, in the same order

field.name: confidence
field.description: high, medium or low: computed from status, a second check, age against the refresh cadence and sampling error (rule: /data/#confidence)

field.name: confidenceBasis
field.description: The reasons for the confidence level, in a short phrase
